relevance_note: The paper describes individual HA20 patients with TNFAIP3 variants, e.g. "P1 was a 15-year-old female with p.T604Rfs*93".
method_note: Hand extraction from a short letter (no tables; only figure legends). Labels P1-P8 are the paper's own. P6-P8 are labelled only in the Fig 1C legend as 'three HA20 patients with quiescent disease'; included because they are labelled HA20 patients, but they have no variant or individual-level clinical detail beyond quiescent disease and non-elevated ISGs. The ages 'aged 28, 32, and 61' for P2-P4 are printed as a list without 'respectively' or per-person labels; not assigned by position (v6 spirit), so ages for P2-P4 are not reported. Sex of P2-P4 is not stated. n_patients_reported left null: the paper states a cohort of twelve HA20 patients but describes five active (P1-P5) and three quiescent (P6-P8) without a single stated total. cites_prior_report left null: ref 2 is cited for the diagnostic methods, not as an earlier description of these patients. 'All patients were diagnosed by Sanger sequencing, and increased NF-κB activity was confirmed with luciferase assay' is about the NIH cohort; applied to P1-P5 (introduced as part of that cohort) for diagnosis basis and functional evidence, but not to P6-P8, whose membership in the cohort is not stated explicitly. 'orogenital ulcerations (P1-P4)' (Fig 1B legend) was taken to mean oral and genital ulcers for each of P1-P4 and both checklist items marked observed. Retinal vasculopathy (P2) was not mapped to the ocular-inflammation or vasculitis checklist items; P5's 'autoinflammatory hepatitis' was not mapped to autoimmune hepatitis. AIDAI score ranges and Fig 1D ESR/CRP values are not per-person statements of elevation, so inflammatory markers are not reported. 'No opportunistic or severe infections were reported during treatment' concerns treatment safety and was not used to exclude recurrent infections. Gene symbol span comes from the introduction; variant lines name only protein changes. No contradictions found.
